car_loan_rate_pct.source: Placeholder: typical Norwegian car-loan nominal rate
car_loan_rate_pct.basis: Owner enters the bank's quoted rate; monthly refresh planned

home_ore_per_kwh.source: Placeholder: Oslo household price incl. grid fee and VAT
home_ore_per_kwh.basis: SSB electricity price series will feed this

petrol_ore_per_litre.source: SSB table 09654, bensin 95 blyfri, monthly average pump price (CC BY 4.0), https://www.ssb.no/statbank/table/09654
petrol_ore_per_litre.basis: Median of the last 12 months (2025-10 to 2026-09); range is the P10-P90 of the last 24 months. September 2026 was 26.18 kr/l, above that range; the owner can enter today's pump price

diesel_ore_per_litre.source: SSB table 09654, avgiftspliktig diesel, monthly average pump price (CC BY 4.0), https://www.ssb.no/statbank/table/09654
diesel_ore_per_litre.basis: Median of the last 12 months (2025-10 to 2026-09); range is the P10-P90 of the last 24 months. September 2026 was 27.52 kr/l, above that range; the owner can enter today's pump price

dealer_exit_friction_pct.basis: Dealer trade-in discount vs private sale

dealer_margin_pct.basis: Dealer asking premium over private asking (market model delta replaces it)

rental_per_month_ore.basis: Zero until the owner states a rental cost

inspection_fee_ore.source: Station prices read 2026-11-02: NAF 1 419 (member) / 1 619, Bertel O. Steen from 1 390, Viking 1 070
inspection_fee_ore.basis: Middle of the published station prices; the user's station sets the real fee

wheel_change_ore.source: NAF Oslo from 525 (17 in) / 675 (SUV), Bertel O. Steen 699, Noddi 699-799 (2026)
wheel_change_ore.basis: Two changes a year at a workshop; zero if the owner changes wheels at home

repair_ev_factor.source: OFV Kostnader ved bilhold 2026: EV service og reparasjoner 3 694 kr vs petrol 5 666 kr at a 550 000 kr price class
repair_ev_factor.basis: Ratio of OFV's EV to petrol service-and-repair cost applied to an ICE repair table

repair_in_warranty_factor.source: Smarte Penger (Bilkostnader - reparasjon, updated 2026-08-06): repairs near zero under a new-car warranty; wear parts are not covered
repair_in_warranty_factor.basis: Share of the repair allowance assumed to be wear the warranty does not cover

repair_source.value: Smarte Penger, Bilkostnader - reparasjon (updated 2026-08-06): repair cost per km by odometer for a mid-size car
repair_source.basis: Editorial estimate for a petrol mid-size car (0.11 kr/km at 20 000 km, 0.45 at 80 000, 0.79 at 100 000, 0.96 at 110 000+); the 40 000 and 60 000 km points are interpolated; scaled by the EV repair factor and the in-warranty repair factor
